doc: World collectibles (docs/collectibles-capture-plan.md, mae 2026-11-11): the kinds a world_collectible box can be. Append only (the order sets class ids in the export). family: resource_hunt (Journal > Map Exploration > Resource Hunt targets: ore, sand, Rolla), misc (flowers and other recipe resources that crop up now and then; many will be added as we explore), chest, pickup (a ground item behind a green dot). cost: free or stamina by default; a box can override it with its own "cost" when the frame shows otherwise. Battle Essence is not a collectible: it comes from a monster fight marked by a stamina_cost board in a blessed zone (box the monster as monster and the board as stamina_cost).

collectibles.name: Ore rock
collectibles.look: grey rocks with blue crystals, a stamina 5 board over them

collectibles.name: Bellflower
collectibles.look: bell-shaped flowers in the Verdantglade Flower Harvest field

collectibles.name: Chest
collectibles.look: a chest on the ground; walking onto it opens it

collectibles.name: Ground pickup
collectibles.look: an item on the ground behind a green minimap dot; rarer ones glow blue (R-122)
